source: Auf der Reise durch die Leere der ewigen Nacht gibt es wunderliche und widersinnige Erzählungen, abwegige und absurde Dinge. Mysteriöse Geschichten, bei denen Wahrheit und Lüge verschmelzen, schwirren von Mund zu Mund und durch das Internet. Außenstehende amüsieren sich an den Gerüchten; doch wer darin gefangen ist, kann schwer unterscheiden zwischen Wirklichkeit und Illusion.
target: Sailing through the void named eternal night, there are always strange and unbelievable tales, utterly unfounded and fantastical. Mysterious stories — indistinguishable between truth and falsehood — flicker between people's words and the internet. Those who watch from the sidelines find amusement in the whimsical narratives, while those caught up in them struggle to discern reality from illusion.

target: The moon shines bright on gilded trees, and the flowers offer forth colors of first blooming. March 7th takes up a pair of peach-colored blades and devotes herself to the way of the sword. source: Der lange erhaltene Frieden und die Harmonie wurden durch eine plötzliche Invasion unterbrochen. In der Raumstation jedoch mussten nicht die kaputten Ausrüstungsteile aus dem Weg geräumt werden, sondern das finstere Geflüster und die Angst, die tief in den Herzen der Menschen versteckt war.
target: A sudden invasion broke the long-maintained peace and harmony. However, in the space station, what needed to be cleaned up is not the broken pieces of equipment, but the sinister whispers and the fear hidden deep inside people's hearts.

source: Der riesige Ofen schaut auf die Menschen herab, die von der Winterstadt verlassen wurden. Unter schlechter werdenden Lebensbedingungen tun alle ihr Bestes, um zu überleben, und bereichern ihr Leben mit spannenden Geschichten.

source: Di atas panggung yang tidak berubah selama ribuan tahun, orang yang lewat, yang datang dan pergi menampilkan repertoar yang selalu berubah. Mereka semua adalah karakter pendukung, tapi mereka adalah protagonis dari kehidupan mereka sendiri.

source: Di bawah bantuanmu, orang-orang dari Underworld membebaskan diri dari sangkar yang telah dirancang Svarog untuk mereka. Untuk "melestarikan" kebebasan Belobog dan untuk melanjutkan perjalanan antarbintang Express, kamu harus kembali ke Overworld dan menantang penguasa dunia ini ....

source: Di dalam dunia mimpi, ada sekelompok orang-orang yang khusus. Mereka entah dengan sukarela atau terpaksa meninggalkan suatu emosi, dan dengan demikian, mereka melupakan diri mereka yang sejati secara perlahan. Wahai The Nameless yang baik hati dan pemberani, tolong jaga Dreamville bersama dengan Clockie, dan bantu mereka mencari kembali sebagian dari diri mereka yang hilang itu!
target: In the Dreamscape, a group of special individuals relinquished certain emotions, whether by their own free will or not. Eventually, they forgot their true selves too. O, valiant and kind Nameless, please protect Dreamville with Clockie and retrieve the parts these people have lost!

source: Di kapal yang melayang di langit, orang-orang spesies berumur panjang menyaksikan kelahiran kembali pohon keramat kuno. Ribuan tahun yang lalu, impian mengejar keabadian mengubah mereka selamanya. Ribuan tahun kemudian, apakah mereka menemukan jawaban yang mereka cari?

source: Di malam ilusi yang panjang, pertunjukan kembang api buatan terbesar sepanjang sejarah tidak lain adalah pujian dari alam semesta yang bersinar dan segera memudar setelah mekar.

source: En el escenario que nunca cambia, los transeúntes interpretan espectáculos de persuasión caleidoscópica. Parecen actores secundarios, pero son los protagonistas de sus propias vidas.

source: En el paisaje onírico, hay un grupo de personas especiales que, de manera voluntaria o forzada, renunciaron a ciertas emociones, y terminaron olvidando poco a poco su verdadero yo. Oh, valiente y amable Anónimo, ¡protege Villa Ensueño con Relojito y recupera lo que estas personas han perdido!

source: En la Escuela Grafía se alzan las llamas de la guerra, y el peligro acecha en las sombras. ¡Reúne a tu ejército de eterae, desafía a los héroes de esta era caótica y recupera la paz de antaño!
target: Graphia Academy is engulfed in chaos, with danger lurking at every turn. Rally your wispae army, challenge the heroes of this turbulent era, and reclaim the peace of old!

source: En la cima de la torre cercana a la fabuluna, la Bufona teje los corazones de la gente y los convierte en un teatro de marionetas en la palma de sus manos. En ese instante, a la gente se le concede la libertad de la Exultación y se le imponen los grilletes de la felicidad...
target: Near the spire's peak, approaching Phantasmoon, the Fool weaves the hearts of men into a marionette theater within her palms. In this moment, people are bestowed the freedom of Elation. In this moment, people are shackled by the chains of happiness...

source: En la nave que viaja por el vacío de la noche eterna siempre se oyen cosas raras y rumores ridículos. Historias misteriosas, ciertas o no, vuelan entre el mundo real y la red. Para quienes observan desde un lado, no son más que rumores interesantes; pero para quienes se ven involucrados en ellas no es tan fácil distinguir la realidad de la ilusión.
target: Sailing through the void named eternal night, there are always strange and unbelievable tales, utterly unfounded and fantastical. Mysterious stories — indistinguishable between truth and falsehood — flicker between people's words and the internet. Those who watch from the sidelines find amusement in the whimsical narratives, while those caught up in them struggle to discern reality from illusion.

source: En la tierra de la Exultación, bajo el manto de la fabuluna, todo puede suceder. Crisis, oportunidades y, sobre todo, bromas.
target: In the land of Elation shrouded by the Phantasmoon, anything can happen. Crisis, opportunity, or just a cosmic punchline.

source: En los últimos setecientos años, la ciudad de Belobog ha vivido numerosas agitaciones y cambios. Durante tu viaje para derrotar a la conspiración del Estelaron, te has convertido en parte de la historia. Dicen que el magnífico museo del distrito administrativo pronto abrirá sus puertas. Tal vez ahí puedas encontrar tu propia huella como trazacaminos...
target: In the past 700 years, the city of Belobog has seen many turmoils and changes. During your journey to vanquish the Stellaron conspiracy, you have become part of the city's history. It's said that the grand museum at the Administrative District will open soon. Maybe you'll find marks of your Trailblaze there...

source: Trong 700 năm qua, thành phố Belobog này đã trải qua rất nhiều biến cố và thay đổi. Trong quá trình phá tan âm mưu Stellaron, các bạn đã trở thành một phần trong lịch sử. Nghe nói Viện Bảo Tàng hùng vĩ của Khu Hành Chính sắp được mở, có lẽ bạn có thể tìm thấy vết tích mà chính mình đã từng khai phá ở nơi đó...
target: In the past 700 years, the city of Belobog has seen many turmoils and changes. During your journey to vanquish the Stellaron conspiracy, you have become part of the city's history. It's said that the grand museum at the Administrative District will open soon. Maybe you'll find marks of your Trailblaze there...

source: Trong Cõi Mộng có một nhóm người đặc biệt, họ tự nguyện hoặc bị ép buộc từ bỏ một loại cảm xúc nào đó, từ đó dần dần quên đi bản chất thực sự của bản thân. Khách Vô Danh tốt bụng và dũng cảm, hãy cùng Cậu Bé Đồng Hồ bảo vệ Thị Trấn Mộng Đẹp, để họ có thể tìm lại một phần đã mất của chính mình!
target: In the Dreamscape, a group of special individuals relinquished certain emotions, whether by their own free will or not. Eventually, they forgot their true selves too. O, valiant and kind Nameless, please protect Dreamville with Clockie and retrieve the parts these people have lost!

source: Trong Thời Đại Của Chúng Tôi
target: In Our Time

source: Trong con tàu trôi nổi giữa các thiên hà, những người trường sinh đã chứng kiến sự tái sinh của cây cổ thụ linh thiêng. Hàng thiên niên kỷ trước, việc theo đuổi sự bất tử đã thay đổi vĩnh viễn con người họ. Hàng thiên niên kỷ sau, họ đã tìm thấy câu trả lời mà họ muốn tìm kiếm chưa?
target: On an intergalactic vessel, long-living individuals witnessed the rebirth of an ancient sacred tree. Millenia ago, the pursuit of immortality changed people permanently. Now, millenia since, have they found the answer they seek?

source: Trong một đêm ảo giác dài đằng đẵng, một màn trình diễn pháo hoa ảo long trọng nhất từ trước đến nay, nó được xem như là một bài thơ ca tụng chợt nổi lên rồi vụt tắt trong vũ trụ bao la.
target: On a long, sanguine night wreathed in illusions, the greatest display of fabricated fireworks is but a hymn from a universe that has bloomed and withered thereafter.

source: 梦境是神明的诏谕、梦境是灵魂的游荡、梦境是魔鬼的引诱、梦境是欲望的投射…古往今来，人们用尽各种方式解释梦的本质，但在匹诺康尼，梦境并非真实世界投射于忆质的倒影，它即是真实世界本身。
target: The Dreamscape is the decree of gods. The Dreamscape is the place where souls wander. The Dreamscape is where demons ply their seduction... Humans have exhausted all kinds of methods to explain the essence of dreams since time immemorial. However, in Penacony, the Dreamscape might not merely be the inverted image cast by reality onto memoria. The Dreamscape is reality itself.
